FLUIDLOVEBAND-SETLIST_POWER.title: Setlist
FLUIDLOVEBAND-SETLIST_POWER.description: Every card you play adds its role as a note. 3 notes play a Song: 3 the same is a [gold]Solo[/gold], one of each is a [gold]Full Band[/gold] (+1 [gold]Groove[/gold]), 2 + 1 is a [gold]Jam[/gold]. The bar above your Energy shows what the next note will play.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-SETLIST_POWER.smartDescrip: Every card you play adds its role as a note. 3 notes play a Song: 3 the same is a [gold]Solo[/gold], one of each is a [gold]Full Band[/gold] (+1 [gold]Groove[/gold]), 2 + 1 is a [gold]Jam[/gold]. The bar above your Energy shows what the next note will play.
